name: JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Miami
insider_take: This towering luxury landmark defines Miami's skyline with two gleaming 30-story towers that house one of the largest hotels in the Southeast.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Marquis Miami is an architectural marvel featuring the largest LED installation in the world on its exterior - a mesmerizing 30-story digital canvas that transforms the building into a work of art each night. Located in the heart of downtown's financial district, this Luminous Collection property offers direct indoor access to the Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts and sits atop the Miami Central Station, connecting guests to the airport and beyond.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 20+ facing southeast for stunning sunrise views over Biscayne Bay and the Port of Miami - you'll watch cruise ships depart while sipping your morning coffee.
dont_miss: The hotel's Level 25 pool deck offers breathtaking 360-degree views of Miami, while the building's exterior LED light show runs nightly from sunset to 11 PM. Walk just two blocks to the historic Freedom Tower, Miami's "Ellis Island," or catch a world-class performance at the adjacent Arsht Center without stepping outside.
pros: Prime downtown Miami location with direct access to shopping and dining
Luxurious amenities including rooftop pool and spa facilities
Multiple dining venues with acclaimed culinary offerings
Extensive conference and event facilities for business travelers
cons: Urban setting may lack beachfront access
